description: The Technical University of Munich provides data for temperature-path-dependent voltage hysteresis and its effect on lithium-ion entropy estimates. Native metadata identifies three temperature profiles, cell-voltage responses and calculated entropy coefficients. The source describes data organised by publication plots and subplots with an accompanying contents document. Simulation uses: the EVERLASTING parent establishes an electric-vehicle battery monitoring and prediction context. These records provide supporting study outputs; executable models or full raw experimental inventories are not asserted. Coverage: detailed test periods, sampling intervals and geographic extents are unstated. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata identifies this release. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Cost and present distribution access remain unknown. Caveats: fields, units and accuracy were not independently inspected. Related battery studies retain different native releases and modelling questions.
